name: Black-Scholes Option Greeks
desc: European call and put prices with Delta, Gamma, Vega, Theta and Rho under Black-Scholes-Merton with dividend yield. Fill the rate from the U.S. Treasury curve in one click.
chips: Greeks per day / per vol point

name: Implied Volatility Smile & Surface
desc: Back out implied volatility across strikes and expiries, infer the forward from put-call parity, fit skew and curvature, and view the surface with a calendar-arbitrage check.

name: Performance & Drawdown Analytics
desc: Paste an equity curve, returns or PnL to get Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, max drawdown and its duration, VaR/CVaR and a monthly table, with zoomable charts and statistics for any selected period.

name: Markowitz Efficient Frontier
desc: Exact long-only maximum-Sharpe portfolio, efficient frontier, capital market line and minimum-variance portfolio for three assets with your own correlations.

name: Monte Carlo Asset Simulator
desc: Simulate price paths under Geometric Brownian Motion with exact log-normal steps; terminal percentiles and horizon VaR compared with closed-form values.
